title: colmap4d time_meta.json
$comment: INFORMATIVE, not normative. The prose of spec section I.C is authoritative; this schema is a convenience for tool authors and an optional advisory check. It is INFORMATIVE by logical necessity, not merely by posture: I.C makes it a normative rule that a reader MUST tolerate unknown top-level and unknown device fields (forward compatibility). A normative schema that strictly validated structure would reject those unknown fields and thereby contradict that MUST. Hence every object here sets additionalProperties:true, and no tool may treat a schema failure as a conformance failure.

colmap4d_spec.description: Spec version the file targets, e.g. "0.2-draft".

time_convention.description: How each image's t is defined. v1 defines only "mid_exposure"; reserved others may follow, so this is not enum-constrained.

time_unit.description: If present, must be "ns" (T_NS is always nanoseconds).

devices.description: device_id -> device object. Provenance only; not a conformance gate (I.C).

camera_ids.description: COLMAP CAMERA_IDs produced by this device (device -> many, one-to-many hint).
